description:
Extend the explicit calibration action's sweep to the sweepable follow-on threshold fields.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §5.1-§5.2 fix the sweepability test and the split: eleven sweepable threshold fields, every one except the interpolation crossover depending on the profile-steered two-process technique that the karatsuba_min_degree steering mechanism provides. This design adds no second steering mechanism.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The calibration action sweeps the eleven sweepable follow-on threshold fields through the standing crossover rule, reusing the existing profile-steering mechanism for fields whose arms need steering.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each field's outcome - measured, tie, non-monotone, or uncalibrated - is recorded in the calibration receipt, and non-sweepable fields stay omitted from committed profiles under the standing omission rule.
- [hard] REQ-03: Calibration remains an explicit benchmark action with no build side effect, and committed profiles regenerated from a sweep carry provenance per the standing design.
title: Extend the calibration sweep to the follow-on threshold fields
